subject: general
question: Why are the Western Ghats considered globally significant according to UNESCO?

options.text: They categorize urban rivers based on their economic contribution to the city.
They influence the Indian monsoon and are among the world's top biodiversity hotspots.
They are located near the equator and host polar species.
They form the only volcanic plateau in peninsular India with desert flora.

solution:
The correct answer is __**They influence the Indian monsoon and are among the world's top biodiversity hotspots**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Western Ghats are recognized globally as one of the **world's eight "hottest hotspots" of biological diversity**, as per UNESCO.
 
• They play a crucial role in influencing the **Indian monsoon**, acting as a barrier to moisture-laden winds and triggering rainfall.
 
• They are home to an exceptional level of **endemic species**, including plants, animals, birds, and amphibians that are unique to this region.
 
• The Western Ghats are designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site due to their **ecological importance and rich biodiversity**.
 
• Spread across six Indian states, these mountains are critical to **water security**, as they host several important rivers and watersheds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Focus Areas of UNESCO (Programmes):**

 
 
• Education: Quality education for all, literacy, lifelong learning.
 
• Natural Sciences: Supporting science for sustainability, ocean health, biodiversity.
 
• Social & Human Sciences: Addressing ethical challenges, promoting inclusive societies, fighting racism.
 
• Culture: Safeguarding heritage (World Heritage Sites, Intangible Heritage), promoting diversity, creativity.
 
• Communication & Information: Upholding freedom of expression, press freedom, digital governance, information literacy.
